SYSTEM_ALERT.label: System Alert
SYSTEM_ALERT.description: Appears in the notification centre with a priority and optional expiry.

DASHBOARD_PIN.label: Dashboard Pin
DASHBOARD_PIN.description: Pinned to the dashboard for a defined time window.

APP_OVERLAY.label: App Overlay
APP_OVERLAY.description: Full-screen message shown the next time the app is opened.

DM.label: Direct Message
DM.description: Lands in the inbox as a message. Replies can be allowed.

STREAM.label: Stream
STREAM.description: Posts to a batch or class discussion stream.

RESOURCES.label: Resources
RESOURCES.description: Files the announcement into a resources folder.

TASKS.label: Tasks
TASKS.description: Creates a task with a go-live time and deadline.

PUSH_NOTIFICATION.label: Push notification
PUSH_NOTIFICATION.description: Mobile and web push. Free, instant, best for short nudges.

EMAIL.label: Email
EMAIL.description: Rich HTML email from one of your verified sender addresses.

WHATSAPP.label: WhatsApp
WHATSAPP.description: Sent through an approved WhatsApp Business template.
